description: This file implements the StorageManager class for managing storage operations such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes methods for configuration, storage management, and logging, and interacts with external components like RequestHandler and system info.

classes.name: StorageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements storage management functionalities such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications, with configuration and lifecycle management.

methods.name: StorageManagerImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StorageManagerImplementation instance.

methods.name: ~StorageManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that releases resources and cleans up.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage manager with the provided service, setting up paths and initializing storage components.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified app ID and size, returning the storage path.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage information and location for a given app ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a given app ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified app ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all storage data except for exempted app IDs.
